name: academic-research-suite
title_zh: 从研究问题到投稿信的全流程学术写作工作台
tagline_zh: 文献综述、元分析、手稿评审、审稿模拟、编辑决策信——一套流程走完，不用在五个工具间来回搬运上下文。
tagline_en: One workflow for lit review, meta-analysis, manuscript review, reviewer simulation, and decision letters—no more.
desc_en: ARS-Codex workflows for research, academic writing, manuscript review, research-to-paper pipelines, and experiment planning. Use when the user asks for deep research, literature review, systematic review, meta-analysis, research question refinement, academic paper drafting, paper revision, citation or integrity checks, reviewer simulation, peer review, editorial decision letters, research-to-paper
why_zh: 把学术写作拆成可复用的流水线节点，每个节点输出结构化中间产物，下一节点直接消费，不丢上下文。
why_en: Breaks academic writing into reusable pipeline stages, each emitting structured artifacts the next stage consumes—no context loss.
limit_zh: 只覆盖论文写作与评审流程，不处理实验设计的数据分析部分；需要你已有文献 PDF 或检索结果，否则综述节点会卡住。
limit_en: Covers writing/review only, not data analysis. Requires your own PDFs or search results; lit-review node stalls without them.
